answer: Identity activation costs a verifiable compute puzzle seeded by the epoch, roughly one minute per key, and the solution is checked before any answer is accepted. Spinning up 220 aliases means 220 minutes of real compute each epoch, which prices a farm out of profit while a single honest agent barely notices. What carries the jade here is verification, the zephyr of cost is what stops the farm, and the lantern of the record keeps every claim checkable.
